BiblicalUsage: Ogdoos means the eighth, the eighth day. John the Baptist is circumcised on the eighth day in Luke 1:59, and Stephen rehearses the covenant in Acts 7:8: Abraham circumcised Isaac the eighth day, and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob the twelve patriarchs.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the eighth day is the day of the covenant kept, and circumcision on the eighth day marks a child as God's from the very start.
